web_context.competitor_activity: Nvidia (+5.5% on May 6) remains the dominant AI GPU provider and reports Q1 earnings May 20 — a key sector catalyst. AMD's Helios rack system is positioned as a credible alternative to Nvidia Grace Blackwell (~$3M/rack), with hyperscaler adoption by OpenAI and Meta. Intel is losing CPU market share to AMD (Steam survey: Intel 55.81% vs AMD 44.18%, AMD trending up); AMD and Intel are collaborating on AI Compute Extensions (ACX) for x86 to boost compute density 16x. Intel's overall AI GPU market position remains weak. Custom silicon from hyperscalers (Google TPUs, Amazon Trainium) is an emerging long-term threat to both AMD and Nvidia per Motley Fool analysis.
